same_controls_similarity_diagnostic.policy: Algebraic diagnostic only. Full original control set, no deletions or coordinate changes. Not a fresh result or adopted replacement.

trial_policy: Diagnostic only. No trial is adopted, no checks removed, no bias correction applied. Prior checks are known and cannot supply fresh validation.
baseline_role_now: Known diagnostic checks; original first-round validation status preserved in baseline record

review_scope.context: Complete scan/reference context and all control/check locations inspected
review_scope.native_details: Four largest-error known checks (all when fewer than four) and two largest fitting-residual controls; additional focused pairs where ambiguity required
review_scope.not_claimed: Exhaustive second native audit of every point, fresh validation on unchanged sheets, measured historical accuracy floor, or geographic/user acceptance

source_uncertainty_policy: Original per-point uncertainty retained, never subtracted from errors. Generalized geometry is a possible explanation, not a measured floor or proof of historical change.
decision: retain baseline failure; no accepted replacement
visual_findings: Cape George Q06 creek reaches shore south of a curved coastal bend, but modern network has additional closely spaced mouths. Source thin creek tracing is plausible; 311 m error does not establish which neighbouring mouth is equivalent. Lakevale Q02/Q03 and Creeping Head-adjacent mouth are distinguishable. Retain failure pending secure coast-wide topology rather than shift a mouth.
baseline_limitations: Main: five controls and only four independent coastal checks give RMS 174.43 m, failing the 100 m ceiling. Median 97.05 m, P95 285.41 m and maximum 311.28 m also exceed suggested companion bounds. Western Antigonish Harbour and interior lack secure local controls/checks.

Inset: two controls and only two independent southern-corridor checks give RMS 89.34 m, median 79.37 m, P95 116.29 m and maximum 120.39 m. RMS passes numerically, median exceeds suggested 75 m, and this extremely small sample does not establish whole-inset accuracy.
Doctors Brook/Malignant Cove northern inset, western main estuary, parcel interiors and harbour works remain unvalidated. Their complete imagery is retained as provisional extrapolation.

Near-zero inset fitting residual follows from the two-control similarity and provides no accuracy evidence. Two-point empirical P95 has little statistical support; no confidence interpretation is made.
Working source uncertainty is 12 px, raised to 18 px at generalized Creeping Head, Lakevale bank and Cape George corner.
control_findings: Ballantyne-adjacent mouth and Cape George southwest corner are identifiable from coast sequence, but new mouths visible in modern data leave local check ambiguity.
decision_basis: No evidenced point correction or independently supported replacement established. Keep original fit, every original diagnostic check, source mask and inset placement. Lower residual under a trial alone is insufficient.
